title: SM Field-Oriented Control
text: Synchronous machine field-oriented control, 6 inputs, 3 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {Control mode}, {Nominal dc-link voltage (V)} sets the rated DC voltage, {Maximum power (W)} sets the maximum power, {Maximum torque (N*m)} sets the maximum torque, {Maximum field current (A)} sets the maximum field current, {Inverter dc-link voltage threshold (V)} sets the dC-link voltage threshold, {Number of rotor pole pairs} sets the pole pairs, {Fundamental sample time (s)} sets the block sample time 5e-6, {Control Type} controls type strategy, {Controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain of PI controller, {Controller integral gain} sets the integral gain of PI controller, {P controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain of P controller, {Integral anti-windup gain} sets the anti-windup gain, {Current references} sets the current reference strategy Zero d-axis, {Mechanical speed vector, wMechanical (rpm)} sets the rotor speed lookup vector, {Torque reference vector, TqRef (N*m)} sets the torque reference lookup vector, {DC-link voltage vector, Vdc (V)} sets the dC-link voltage lookup vector, {D-axis current reference matrix, id(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference d-axis current values zeros, {Q-axis current reference matrix, iq(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc) (A)} sets the reference q-axis current values zeros, {Field current reference matrix, if(wMechanical,TqRef,Vdc), (A)} sets the reference field current values zeros, {Torque constant} sets the motor torque constant, {D-axis current proportional gain} sets the d-axis proportional gain, {D-axis current integral gain} sets the d-axis integral gain, {D-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the d-axis anti-windup gain, {Q-axis current proportional gain} sets the q-axis proportional gain, {Q-axis current integral gain} sets the q-axis integral gain, {Q-axis current anti-windup gain} sets the q-axis anti-windup gain, {Field current proportional gain} sets the field winding proportional gain, {Field current integral gain} sets the field winding integral gain, {Field current anti-windup gain} sets the field winding anti-windup gain, {Axis prioritization}, {Enable zero cancellation} sets the feedforward zero cancellation, {Enable pre-control voltage}, {Machine parameters} sets the machine parameterization Constant, {D-axis inductance (H)} sets the feedforward d-axis inductance, {Q-axis inductance (H)} sets the feedforward q-axis inductance, {Mutual field armature inductance (H)} sets the mutual inductance between field, {D-axis current vector, id (A)} sets the d-axis current breakpoint vector, {Q-axis current vector, iq (A)} sets the q-axis current breakpoint vector, {Field current vector, if (A)} sets the field winding current vector, {Ld matrix, Ld(id,iq) (H)} sets the d-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 *, {Lq matrix, Lq(id,iq) (H)} sets the q-axis inductance lookup data 0.0002 *, {Lmf matrix, Lmf(id,iq,if), (H)} sets the field-armature mutual inductance lookup 0.007 *, {PWM method} sets the pulse width modulation method SVM: space vector, {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate, {Chopper type} sets the dC-DC chopper type First and fourth quadrant and {Switching frequency excitation (Hz)} sets the excitation system switching frequency. Values come from the instance.
